get.description:
Asset::class must be given explicitly: passing only the 'website' route
param would let Laravel infer the policy from Website's class (WebsitePolicy,
whose viewAny() is unconditionally true for any member) instead of the
AssetPolicy::viewAny() we actually want here.

and its owner (layout/page version) can never be changed after upload

InviteWebsiteUserRequest::authorize(), since it depends on the requested role

layout.description:
The layout as it existed at publish time (layout_snapshot), not
whatever the live Layout looks like now — a published version is
immutable, and this is the endpoint that guarantee is for.

layout_id.description:
Required when page_version_id is absent. Cannot be combined with page_version_id.
The layout must belong to this website.

page_version_id.description:
Required when layout_id is absent. Cannot be combined with layout_id.
The page version must belong to this website.

subdomain.description:
'nullable' is required because Laravel's ConvertEmptyStringsToNull middleware
turns an explicit subdomain: "" (meaning "root domain, no subdomain") into null
before validation runs.
